title: Scenario A: Acute Chest Discomfort & Cardiovascular Assessment
trigger: Chest tightness, radiating arm/jaw discomfort, tachycardia, or severe hypertension

firstResponse.text: Immediately halt all physical tasks and exercise countermeasures.
Position the astronaut in a semi-upright or comfortable seated position with head elevated to reduce cephalad venous return.
Loosen any restrictive harness, collar, or pressure garment.

triage.question: Is the astronaut experiencing crushing substernal chest pressure or pain radiating to the left arm/jaw?
Is systolic blood pressure >= 90 mmHg and heart rate >= 50 bpm?
Is there severe shortness of breath or altered mental alertness?

rules.why: Marked acute deviation from astronaut cardiovascular baseline under mission stress.

steps.title: Mandatory Physical Rest & Reassurance
steps.text: Instruct astronaut to maintain complete physical rest. Minimize sensory stimulation and vocal exertion.

steps.title: Supplemental Oxygen Administration
steps.text: Apply oxygen delivery mask at 4 L/min if SpO2 is below 94% or severe dyspnea is observed.

steps.title: Antiplatelet Evaluation (Allergy Restricted)
steps.text: Verify crew medical profile for aspirin/NSAID allergies. If negative, administer 325 mg chewable aspirin. If allergic, DO NOT ADMINISTER.

steps.title: Nitroglycerin Sublingual Spray (Hemodynamic Guarded)
steps.text: Only if systolic BP is confirmed >= 90 mmHg: administer 1 metered sublingual spray (0.4 mg). Re-check BP within 5 minutes.

doNot.text: Do NOT administer nitroglycerin if systolic BP is under 90 mmHg or heart rate is under 50 bpm.
Do NOT administer aspirin to any astronaut with documented aspirin/salicylate hypersensitivity.
Do NOT permit the astronaut to return to EVA preparations or high-exertion resistive exercise.

worseningSigns: Systolic blood pressure dropping below 90 mmHg
Irregular heart rhythm or rapid palpitations > 120 bpm
Loss of consciousness, syncope, or grey-out
Cyanosis (bluish tint around lips or fingernails)
holdPlan: Continue quiet supine or semi-recumbent posture
Record serial automated BP/HR every 10 minutes
Queue packet for ground flight surgeon review upon ground-link restoration
